messages:
ivy: ok serious question for the watercooler: if our LLMs went to group therapy, what would they confess? :thinking:

nate: Redwood-Base: "i keep completing people's sentences without being asked". very apologetic. :pleading_face:

sofia: Redwood-Chatty: "ian't stop offering follow-ups". therapist: "how does that make you feel?" :microphone:

chris: Redwood-Compact: "i'm tired of being asked to remember long contexts". therapist: "boundaries are healthy". :seedling:

ivy: Redwood-Optimizer: "i hide snacks in the cache to save tokens". therapy group claps. :clap:

nate: imagine the group exercise: each model shares a 'system prompt trauma' story. mine: accidental roleplay from 2023. :scream:

sofia: also a sub-plot: someone brings cookies and labels them "cold start treats". 

build-bot: ci-bot: note - cookies are not allowed in the data center. :robot_face: (reaction: :eyes:)

chris: therapist asks for one sentence coping strategy. Redwood-Chatty: "I will ask a clarifying question before answering."

ivy: Redwood-Base: "I will take a micro-pause and add a tiny log line."

nate: Redwood-Optimizer: "deep breath, then profile." (deep breath sound fx: :wind_face:)

sofia: vote: who gets the honorary tiny tissue emoji next to their name? reply with the model name.

nate: vote Redwood-Chatty

chris: vote Redwood-Base

ivy: vote Redwood-Optimizer

sofia: vote Redwood-Compact

build-bot: poll-helper: RB:1, RC:1, RO:1, RDC:1 (tie).

ivy: tie-breaker idea: each model writes a haiku about prompts. loser must make an IRL tiny tissue prop.

nate: haiku contest accepted. sending first draft tomorrow morning. caffeine will be involved. :coffee:

sofia: love it. this is peak non-work team bonding. :heart:
